bullets: Owned an end-to-end authorization caching solution — replaced a 100M+ record materialized view with an event-driven in-memory cache, cutting auth latency from 1–5s to <10ms p99.
Built 8 CDC event handlers on Kafka/ECS with parallel reads, pipelined writes, optimistic locking, a DLQ, and sub-60s lag observability; scaled to 100K QPS at ~$5.9K/yr vs a $28K/yr alternative.
Published an internal TypeScript authorization library with typed single-call APIs, pooling, and TLS retry — removing main-DB I/O load and standardizing auth across services.
Delivered 70% of a remote provisioning system for the service certificate hierarchy (infra, backend, deploy), automating mTLS issuance and zero-downtime rotation.
Implemented the CA hierarchy on AWS (ECS, Secrets Manager, RDS, SQS) with retries and CloudWatch alarms; cut manual provisioning effort by 80%.
Increased team productivity by 40% by building custom AI integrations and IDE workflows that automated development, documentation, and GitHub/Confluence tasks.
Remediated pentest findings — stored XSS, CSV injection, user enumeration, access-control gaps, and auth rate-limiting — and patched cloud security issues via runtime upgrades.
Built backend REST APIs for an IoT core platform (asset, auth, device management) and contributed to a payment-bridging system with fault-tolerant error handling.
